limitations: Build is fresh QEMU source/object compilation with pinned static dependency-cache reuse, not a fresh dependency build.
Tool observations and bootstrap source copy were captured after execution; outer launch argv is root-provided actual-launch attestation, not an independent exec trace.
All 106 QEMU source files and the 12 historical patches are fingerprint-only; optional source replay requires matching external QEMU source and repository patches.
Original 152-check historical model failure and corrected independent C results remain in the sibling controller archive; this build archive does not relabel them as guest or hardware PASS.
No firmware, ROM, runtime binary, object, static dependency archive or credential bytes are archived.

archive_rules.original_bytes: exact byte copies with source/archive SHA256 equality
archive_rules.generated: explicitly generated explanatory or verification records, never represented as original process output
archive_rules.fingerprint_only: source/dependency/binary bytes deliberately excluded; only path/size/SHA metadata retained
